relationship: new direct report, joining the Platform team

quote.text: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.

title: Welcome to the team, Kenji
body: Welcome to the Platform team. When you talked about your work on the open-source job scheduler, the whole panel lit up, because it's exactly the problem we're about to take on with our build queue.

This week is for settling in: accounts and laptop on Monday, an architecture walkthrough on Tuesday, pairing with Bea on Wednesday, and a small starter task by Thursday. On Friday we'll sit down and talk about what's clear and what isn't.
Bea is your buddy, a few desks over and one message away. No question is too small, and nobody expects you to ship anything big this week.
channel_post: Please welcome Kenji, who joins the Platform team today. Kenji has worked on open-source job schedulers and will start on our build queue. Fun fact he asked us to share: he has climbed Mount Fuji three times. Say hi, and invite him to your favourite lunch spot.

consent.note: Kenji agreed to the scheduler mention and the Fuji fact.

fun_fact.text: Fun fact: "companion" comes from the Latin for "someone you share bread with". Lunch on Wednesday is on us.
